intent: Confirm calendar->kanban->finance integration is on track, audit notification RBAC, put AI chat + talent screening onhold, design a clickable kanban task-detail panel.
summary: Planning/ops session, no app code touched. (1) Confirmed via finance.md and the Phase 10 task list (PSI-100..106) that the calendar -> kanban -> finance streamline is already fully designed and its migration (PSI-101, PR #43) is merged; nothing further needed beyond keeping it unblocked. (2) Audited notifications RLS (m2-notifications.md): access is `user_id = auth.uid()`, no permission key involved, so a plain member already gets and reads their own notifications by identity -- RBAC is already correct here, no code change needed. Noted (not actioned, YAGNI) that `notifications.type` has no finance value yet; only needed once finance notifications are designed. (3) Added `onhold` as a new task status: scripts/obsidian-sync.ts (Status type, STATUSES, LANE label 'On Hold', a Home.md list section) and a new editing rule in list-task-project.md distinguishing it from `blocked` (onhold = human paused a whole feature on purpose; only a human sets it; agents never auto-resume a held task even once its deps are ready). Set PSI-076 (in-app AI chat), PSI-098 (the LLM layer only chat/digest/CV-parsing need; finance's agent tool doesn't depend on it) and the open Phase 8 talent tasks (PSI-081..086, excl. done PSI-080) to onhold. Left PSI-077 and the MCP OAuth tasks untouched -- not named, and holding PSI-098 already stops PSI-077 mechanically. (4) Wrote the task-detail-panel design into kanban.md and added PSI-109 (backlog): click (not drag) opens a Sheet with the full task, an event link when the board has event_id, and a Finance section gated on finance.read reusing finance's entry-form-sheet -- design + task only, since it depends on PSI-104 which is still backlog. Also fixed a process gap: PR #46 (repo hygiene, merged dd3e86e) had no task-list or history entry; retro-added PSI-108 (done) and its entry in this same commit.

changes.note: Add 'onhold' Status value, STATUSES entry, LANE label, Home.md 'On Hold' list
onhold in the allowed-values table and editing rules; PSI-076, PSI-098, PSI-081..086 (excl. PSI-080) set onhold; PSI-108 (done) and PSI-109 (backlog) added
Task detail panel design (event link, gated finance section)
Retroactive record for the PR #46 session

decisions.decision: onhold is a human-only status; agents never set or clear it themselves
decisions.reason: It encodes a product-priority call, not a dependency or blocker fact an agent can observe from the repo
alternatives: Reuse 'blocked' for both meanings (rejected: conflates 'can't proceed' with 'chose not to proceed', which is exactly the ambiguity that fed the PSI-081/082 rework loop found in PSI-108)

decisions.decision: Hold PSI-098 (LLM layer) in addition to the two named features
decisions.reason: Its only consumers are chat (PSI-076), digest (PSI-077, not named) and CV parsing (PSI-082, talent); finance's own agent tool (PSI-105) does not depend on it, so holding it doesn't touch the priority pipeline, and it documents intent instead of leaving the board silent about why PSI-082 stays stuck

decisions.decision: PSI-109 is a design + backlog task, not an implementation this session
decisions.reason: Depends on PSI-104 (finance tab), still backlog; building the panel now would mean guessing the finance UI shape instead of reusing it
alternatives: Build a task-detail sheet now without the finance section, add it later

verification.manual: bun scripts/obsidian-sync.ts (write mode) and bun run agent:check run after all edits.

follow_ups.note: notifications.type has no finance value yet; add one only when finance notifications are actually designed

human_review.reason: Confirm the onhold moves (PSI-076, PSI-098, Phase 8 talent tasks) match intent, and that PSI-109's design is right before it's built
